column3: “How you have helped to no power” is rendered “What a help you are to the weak.”
“Has gone out from you” is rendered “was expressed through you.”
“The throne” is rendered “the full moon”; the Hebrew word may be read either way, and the meaning is uncertain.
“A limit he has drawn a circle” is rendered “He has inscribed a circle.”
“Stirred up” is rendered “quieted”; the Hebrew verb can mean either, and the meaning is uncertain.
“Clearness” is rendered “cleared”; the meaning is uncertain.
“The ends of his ways” is rendered “the fringes of His ways.”
